# Vendored browser assets

These files are served by the lab.
The app does not call a network at runtime.

htmx 1.9.12 `htmx.min.js` came from `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/htmx/1.9.12/htmx.min.js`.
The htmx license file came from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/v1.9.12/LICENSE` because the cdnjs LICENSE URL returned 403.
The download used `curl --ssl-no-revoke`.

CodeMirror 5.65.16 `codemirror.min.js` came from `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/codemirror/5.65.16/codemirror.min.js`.
CodeMirror 5.65.16 `codemirror.min.css` came from `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/codemirror/5.65.16/codemirror.min.css`.
CodeMirror 5.65.16 `mode/sql/sql.min.js` came from `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/codemirror/5.65.16/mode/sql/sql.min.js`.
CodeMirror 5.65.16 `addon/edit/matchbrackets.min.js` came from `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/codemirror/5.65.16/addon/edit/matchbrackets.min.js`.
The CodeMirror license file came from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codemirror/CodeMirror/5.65.16/LICENSE` because the cdnjs LICENSE URL returned 403.

Chart.js 4.4.1 `chart.umd.min.js` came from `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/Chart.js/4.4.1/chart.umd.min.js`.
The Chart.js license file came from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chartjs/Chart.js/v4.4.1/LICENSE.md`.
